Jake — thanks for the note and the clear asks. We can absolutely provide an executive summary immediately and the full report after a short NDA and redaction agreement. Quick answers up front: 

- Scope: the test covered our inference control plane and public API endpoints in the staging environment that mirrors production (no testing against customer production datasets). It included external network testing and authenticated application-level checks.
- Vendor: SecureLytics (cc'd?) performed the assessment; they maintain OSCP/OSWE certifications internally and provide CREST-like QA.
- Remediation status: critical items were patched or mitigated on 2025-06-20; medium items are in progress (target close ~2025-07-15); low items scheduled across July.

I'm attaching a redacted executive summary for your review (redwood_pen_test_exec_summary_redacted_v1.pdf) and a remediation status spreadsheet (remediation_status_20250701.xlsx). For the full technical report we require a signed NDA that includes a clause allowing redaction of exploit steps and any customer-identifying data. I can start the DocuSign flow as soon as you confirm the recipient list for the full report.

Proposed sharing workflow:
1) Exec summary (today) — PDF, redacted to remove exploit PoCs and internal IP addresses.
2) NDA signed by Acme security + procurement.
3) Full report (secure link or encrypted ZIP) after NDA, with redaction log attached.

If you prefer we can also provide remediation evidence (Jira ticket IDs and sanitized screenshots) in lieu of the full report.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Jake / Marissa — adding a few technical clarifications from the security side to avoid follow-ups: 

- Test scope details: SecureLytics executed external black-box testing against the public inference endpoints and performed authenticated testing against the staging management console. No direct testing was performed against customer data stores or production tenant data.
- Findings classification: 1 critical (RCE vector on legacy admin API) — mitigated 2025-06-20 with a config change + patch; 7 medium — 4 remediated, 3 in-progress; 9 low — scheduled.
- Evidence we can share:
  * Redacted executive summary (attached)
  * Remediation status spreadsheet with ticket IDs (we will sanitize any customer identifiers)
  * A remediation slide deck or short video walkthrough if that would be helpful.

On the redaction policy: we redact exploit PoCs and sensitive internal IPs; we do not redact CWE classifications or CVSS scores. If Acme requires a full unredacted report we can provide it under a narrow NDA that lists permitted recipients and forbids downstream distribution.

Happy to hop on a 30-min call to walk through the exec summary if useful.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
